preconditions.description: Attacker must be the owner of the contract.

exploit_hint: The attacker, who must be the contract owner, should call the `setMaxTxAmount` function with the `maxTxAmount` parameter set to 0. This will prevent any non-owner from transferring tokens by causing the `require(amount <= _maxTxAmount)` check in the `_transfer` function to fail for any amount greater than 0.
